Journal

Notes from the road

Ship reviews, resort walkthroughs, and honest comparisons — written from places Chad and I have actually been.

This section is just getting started

The plan is two posts a month, written first-hand rather than assembled from supplier press releases. Below is what's queued. If there's something you'd rather I wrote about first, tell me — I'd genuinely rather write the thing someone is waiting for.

Coming up

  • Virgin Voyages vs. Royal Caribbean for a first cruise

    Two very different answers to the same question, and the one you'll prefer depends almost entirely on whether you want children on the ship.

  • What "all-inclusive" actually includes

    A category-by-category walk through what's genuinely covered, what's a supplement, and where the gap between brochure and bill usually opens up.

  • Alaska: May vs. July vs. September

    Three quite different holidays sold under one name, at three quite different prices.

  • How to read a small group tour's inclusion list

    Where the optional excursions are the actual highlights, the headline price is fiction. How to spot it before you book.

  • The cabin categories worth paying for — and the ones that aren't

    An honest accounting, including the several occasions I've talked people out of a suite.

In the meantime, Chad and I post from wherever we currently are on Instagram.
